section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1968
title: Table 5 presents the percentage distribution of accidental deaths by sex in the different States, Union Territories and Cities. On an average about two thirds of the persons (62.7%), who were involved in accidents, were males. A similar pattern emerged in almost all the States, excepting Jammu & Kashmir, Assam and Punjab, where the percentage of males involved was 71·4%, 73·8% and 85·5% respectively. Among the Union Territories also, the over-all percentage (75·5%) of males involved is higher than the all-India average. Among the comparable cities, Bombay, Calcutta and Delhi indicated more than 70% of male involvement.
